target.title: fix(scripts): bound merge-head-diff-base git operations
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where git operations in the merge-head-diff-base script could hang indefinitely during CI change detection. When git commands encounter network issues or repository corruption, `execFileSync` calls would block without any timeout, stalling automated workflows.

## Why This Change Was Made

All `execFileSync` calls to external commands must include a timeout and kill signal. Without these, transient git issues cause resource leaks and indefinite stalls. This follows the same bounding pattern applied in #109968 (clawtributor GitHub lookups) and #110599 (close-duplicate-prs-after-merge).

## User Impact

Change detection can complete or fail-fast within a bounded deadline instead of blocking indefinitely when git operations are unresponsive.

## Evidence

- Adds `MERGE_DIFF_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000` constant and applies `timeout` + `killSignal: "SIGKILL"` to both `execFileSync("git", ...)` call sites in `listCommitParents` and `resolveCommit`.
- Pattern consistency: matches the bounding approach in `scripts/changed-lanes.mjs` (#110814).
